Storage.//: Durable blob storage. Provider 'filesystem' stores blobs on disk under Root, partitioned per tenant; switch to 'azure' with a real account connection string for the Azure deployment target. Set Root to a persistent, backed-up volume in production. Retention TTLs are the lifecycle policy the janitor enforces (screenshots shorter because they can show PII).

DataProtection.//: Persists the ASP.NET Data Protection key ring so credentials registered via /browsers survive redeploys. BOTH set (the Azure deployment) => the key ring is stored in the KeyRingBlobUri blob and each key is wrapped by the KeyVaultKeyId Key Vault key, authenticated by the app's managed identity (set AZURE_CLIENT_ID for the user-assigned identity). BOTH empty (dev/test default) => the framework's default local key ring. Half-set fails fast at startup. The infra deploy feeds these via Crawldad__DataProtection__* env vars.
